name: select-tabular-${A}
notes: Walk-forward template for the TABULAR class on the minute PANEL (dskit array_panel / panel_torch / panel_score; ADR-0259). One arm = one ColumnSelector over the single panel `{panel.source}`, so every arm sees identical rows and labels; the manifest fills ${arm.*} per lane. The folds are an explicit expanding schedule on W1 only (the last validation window ends before 2026-05-01; a test pins it), the panel's W2 rows are never inside a fold's bands. No raw channels: a context-only model.

fit.notes: The tabular model: one mixture MLP (3 components) reading the kept summary columns plus the asset indicator, 15 horizons from one head. Everything but the arm's `context` selector is fixed across arms, so only the features move.

score.notes: Weighted CRPS = crps + tail_weight * tail_crps on the common grid, averaged over the 15 horizons and both assets; one number per fold, lower is better. It is the walk-forward objective, the same in both classes and every arm, so per-fold differences between arms are paired. rows_sha256 in its artifact proves every arm scored the same rows.

walkforward.notes: Expanding all-prior train windows, one run per fold, the same fold plan for every arm and both classes (it comes from the manifest). `select: min` because the score is a loss; the selection node reads it as `positive difference = dropping the group hurts`.

outputs.notes: Placement only (outside the identity hash): this lane's run root, which holds the fold run directories and the walk-forward summary select-features.json reads.
